body: Refreshed with main (c8a1bab1): merged #1131's refreshed branch `issue/541-sinker-burn-depth` (f3b24dc6) first, then `upstream/main`. Head is now f36c1005. Only `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` conflicted, in both merges. I set it to 24: main is at 18, and the sinker-post stack's process bump takes 24. `generate.rs` `run_job_arms` merged cleanly, because #1131's refresh already holds both the sinker-burn early return and main's body-stack/neck lines. `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the stack's own files. Tests: `camcraft-post --test sinker_post` 6/6. App `sinker_burn` 10/10, `conformance` 7/7, `golden_cl` 25/25, `plasma_post_refusals` 7/7, `smoothing` 7/7. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` is clean: the stack carries the `Cutter::neck` test fix, so the app lib tests compile here. Stays draft.

Refreshed with main (9032da34) only (#1131's branch untouched): one conflict, .claude/PROCESS_VERSION (this branch 24, main 20) -> 25. No code conflicts; posted G-code goldens untouched. Head c4ddcc34. Tests: post sinker_post 6, app sinker_burn 10, conformance 7 - all pass; cargo test -p xtask 37/37; clippy -p app/post/ui/tools/motion/sim --all-targets -D warnings clean. Stays a draft.

Refreshed with main (c6597a76) and #1131 (ed6a1eb4): `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` renumbered (now 28, main is on 24); `solid_law_goldens.rs` kept main's `posted_gates` harness (#1096); `crates/tools/src/electrode.rs` takes `turning: None` for main's new `Tool` field. Head 1b230423.

The two guard failures:
- `recorded_streams::every_shipped_post_script_has_its_suite`: `sinker_post.rs` moves to `crates/post/tests/script_sinker_iso.rs` and adds `post_suite!("sinker-iso.cps")`. The nine recorded mill cases post machine-less, so each golden in `recorded/golden/sinker-iso/` is the post's named refusal ("serves sinker_edm machines only"). The sinker's own stream (the Sinker Burn CL golden, wrapped the way the dump wraps it) posts through the binary on the fixture dialect to `recorded/golden/sinker-iso/sinker_burn_cavity.nc`. That file is byte-identical to app's `nc/sinker-iso/sinker_burn_cavity.nc`. `recorded::verdict_on` / `compare` are split out of `verdict` / `check`. All goldens were written by the suite's own WRITE_GOLDEN path.
- `solid_law_goldens::every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes`: `sinker_burn_cavity.nc` is now judged, not put in UNJUDGED. `posted_gates::sinker_gouge_cells` generates the real Sinker Burn on a sinker over a block whose cavity is the electrode grown by the gap. It proves the program is the CL golden byte for byte, then runs `stock_sim::simulate_document`, the program verdict with the electrode's box atom: 0 gouge cells. I checked by hand that a 5 mm cavity gives 432 gouge cells, so the judge does catch an overburn. No law was loosened.

Tests: post `script_sinker_iso` 16/16, `recorded_streams` 10/10. App `solid_law_goldens` 5/5, `sinker_burn` 10/10, `conformance` 7/7. Clippy on post, app and tools with `-D warnings` is clean.
`coarse_laws`: `every_kind_is_either_judged_or_refused...` passes with #1131's fix. Four other `coarse_laws` tests fail, and the same failure is on main since #1074: the test expects "re-import with a larger budget" but `model_fidelity::TOO_COARSE` now says "larger STEP facet budget". This PR doesn't cause it.

**Still conflicting, so I stopped:** main's newest merge b7d3512e (#1116, op icons) moved `op_icon` out of `panes.rs` into `op_icons.rs`. It also retired the glyph-reuse law: every `OpType` must wear its own SVG-mastered `op-*` icon (`op_icon_table::every_op_kind_has_its_own_svg_mastered_icon`). The stack maps `OpType::SinkerBurn => Icon::Drill`, which main's law now rejects. A real fix needs a new original `op-sinker-burn` SVG master and its PNG. That belongs in #1131, which adds `SinkerBurn`, and #1131 and #1136 now show CONFLICTING too. Once #1131 has the glyph, this PR merges #1131 and then main.

PROCESS_VERSION renumbered to 31: main is on 25, open peers hold 26-30 (#972 28, #1033 29, #1124 30). Head 99bf379f. The version file is the only change. The PR still conflicts with main over the SinkerBurn glyph, as in my comment above.

Refreshed with main and #1131 (50e395e8): merged #1131's reworked EDM base, then upstream/main (6a10c5ad, clean). Head 34bb4413.

What changed:
- `edm.rs`: took #560's section (strict keys, `parse_edm` with the declared kind, conditions in `edm_conditions.rs`) and re-added `codes` on top: it is now one of `COMMON_KEYS` (either EDM kind; the wire post #533 reads its own roles), read after `conditions` and checked by `Edm::is_sane`. Any other unknown key still refuses by name.
- `machine/mod.rs`, `posting.rs`, `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`: kept both sides. `default_post_for(SinkerEdm)` is the sinker post; `WireEdm` stays Builtin (refused by `post_serves` and the engine's serves law).
- The serves law and `posting_family` are different doors, so both stay: `family_at_post` refuses an op whose family the machine cannot run, and `serves_gate` refuses a post dialect on a machine kind it does not declare. The base had no post-dialect refusal for EDM apart from the picker listing, so nothing was removed.
- The fixture `sinker-iso-dialect.mch` already passes the new condition bounds (id `S1`, gap 0.05, undersize 0.1 on a sinker). Unchanged.
- New pin `edm_codes::tests::codes_is_a_key_of_either_edm_kind_and_reads_after_the_strict_keys`. Decision note added to `docs/decisions/542-sinker-iso-post.md`.
- PROCESS_VERSION 31 (main is on 25).

Tests: post `script_sinker_iso` 10/10, `recorded_streams` 16/16, post lib 38/38; app `solid_law_goldens` 5, `sinker_burn` 10, `conformance` 7, `coarse_laws` 6, `plasma_post_refusals` 7, `smoothing` 7, `edm_machine` 5, `edm_conditions` 1, all green. `clippy -D warnings` is clean on post, app and tools (all targets). Still a draft.

Refreshed with #1131 5fc71cf2 (ab339b70): merged #1131's test-only commit; the one conflict (crates/app/tests/sinker_burn.rs) took #1131's tests/edm/sinker_fixture.rs module; #542's three post tests keep their calls via `use sinker_fixture::*`, and `sinker_doc_on` (a sinker document on a given machine text) moved into the fixture with `sinker_doc` delegating to it; DIALECT/SINKER_POST/post_burn stay local. posted_gates::sinker_gouge_cells uses no moved helper. upstream/main already contained; PROCESS_VERSION stays 31. Tests: sinker_burn 10/10 (7 from #1131 + 3 from #542), sinker_burn_held 6/6, stock_sim_held lib 2/2, solid_law_goldens 5/5, conformance 7/7, coarse_laws 6/6, post script_sinker_iso 16/16, recorded_streams 10/10, clippy -D warnings (app, post, all targets) clean.

This conflicts with main (now 62a2c93a). Two files: `crates/post/tests/recorded/mod.rs` - the harness changed on both sides (your branch passes `--machine` straight through; main now reads the case's machine, mirrors it with `machine::mirror` into a temp `.mch` and passes that) - same-logic, needs your judgement, likely folding your change into main's mirror block; and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (yours 31 vs main's 29 - 31 stands unless a sibling claim lands first). Please `git merge upstream/main`, resolve deliberately, and push.
